disclaimer: Halal certification rules and accredited body lists change. Verify with MOIAT directly before quoting figures.

authority.name: Ministry of Industry and Advanced Technology
authority.absorbed: ESMA (Emirates Authority for Standardization and Metrology) was absorbed into MOIAT in 2020. The halal scheme moved with it.
authority.warning: ESMA is no longer an active authority. Do not refer founders to ESMA for halal certification.

standards.scope: General requirements for halal certification bodies
Requirements for halal cosmetics and personal care products

halal_mark.name: UAE Halal Mark
halal_mark.notes: The Halal National Mark is optional. Product halal certification and permission to use the national mark are separate requirements; consult MOIAT and a registered certification body for the applicable product scope.

products_requiring_certification: Food products and ingredients subject to the UAE halal control scheme
Cosmetics and personal care products presented as halal
Slaughterhouses and slaughtered animals within the applicable halal scheme

certification_bodies.api_status: MOIAT publishes an online directory of registered bodies and their status and scope. No documented public product-verification API was identified in this review.

hcb_registration.notes: AED 2,000 covers one registration domain plus one certificate. Each additional domain costs AED 1,000; accreditation and assessor expenses can be additional. These are certification-body registration fees, not a product certification quote.

recommended_approach: Curated reference data plus a scheduled scrape of the HCB directory. No real-time API exists. Do not promise product-level certification lookup.
certification_scope_note: These are scheme categories, not a statement that every food, cosmetic, medicine, or textile must carry halal certification or the optional National Mark. Confirm the product, ingredients, claims, and import requirements with MOIAT.
last_refresh_scope: Targeted correctness audit of 2026-09-05: corrected the 2055-2 and 2055-4 standard scopes, distinguished optional National Mark use from product certification, refreshed MOIAT directory links, and clarified per-domain HCB fees against MOIAT sources. Not a full re-verification of every field in this pack.
